finalText:
Root cause: Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 died.

Timeline:
- 02:14:07 `redis connection lost: ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. api falls back to direct store reads.
- Cache miss storm starts immediately, store gets hammered, every service (api/worker-1/worker-2/scheduler) start hitting 5000ms TimeoutError on repeat, every ~2s.
- Request queue depth climbs steady from ~52 → past its own max of 500 (line 644, 02:29:06) → still climbing to 568 by 02:31:24. Cap not enforced — no backpressure/shed.
- api tried redis reconnect 12 times (attempt 0 at 02:15:26 through attempt 12 at 02:31:26), all ECONNREFUSED. Redis never came back.
- 02:31:44 `worker-2` heap OOM ("request backlog") — unbounded queue growth exhausted memory.
- 02:31:45 supervisor restarts worker-2 (exit code 134 = abort/OOM).
- 02:31:52 api itself unresponsive, supervisor kills whole process group — service down.

Chain: redis outage → cache fallback overload store → timeouts cascade across all services → queue depth cap ignored, grows unbounded → worker-2 OOM → api unresponsive → full outage. ~17.5 min from redis loss to death.

Fix priorities: enforce queue depth cap (reject/shed load past 500, don't just log warn), circuit-breaker on store calls during cache outage, alert on redis reconnect failures (should've paged way before attempt 12), check why 10.0.0.12:6379 died.
